note: The session's web search allowance was already used up when this part began, so nobody here was searched for. Candidates were looked up only on pages whose address was known or could be tried directly: campaign addresses tried by name, Wikipedia, the Oakland County Democratic Party's endorsements page, and a few governments' and school districts' own pages. Checked and found nothing: Oakland County Probate Court's judges page (Hallmark is not a sitting judge), and the board pages of Kelloggsville, Zeeland, Avondale and Detroit schools (Tanis, Miller, Enderle and Ivey are not listed as members). Not reached: the Third Circuit Court's and 36th District Court's judge pages (one loads by script, one answered 404), Ballotpedia (empty for scripts), the Oakland County Republican slate page (loads by script, so its endorsements of Neilson and Hallmark could not be seen and are not recorded here), the U.S. Taxpayers Party's candidate page (title only), and the other school districts' sites. Angela Witwer's campaign address was not found. Mark Tisdel's birth date on Wikipedia has no citation and is left out. Polehanki has no member id in our record, so her official page, birth year and offices are given. A blank here means not looked up or not found, not that nothing exists.
